docs.text:
name: CI

# First committed workflow in this repo (Slice 14 Phase A / DEC-14-5).
# Two gates: `typecheck` (tsc --noEmit type-regression) and `golden-numbers`
# (pins payloadAtC3 / deliveredMassKg — the df3225f data-literal guard).
# It is deliberately SEPARATE from the GitHub Pages deploy: it never builds
# docs/, never deploys, never writes to the repo. Pages continues to serve from
# the committed docs/ folder via built-in branch-deploy, untouched by this workflow.

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  typecheck:
    name: tsc --noEmit
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Typecheck (tsc --noEmit)
        run: npx tsc --noEmit

  build:
    name: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build
        run: npm run build

  golden-numbers:
    name: golden-numbers (df3225f guard)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          # Node 24: the golden test imports production TypeScript directly via
          # native type-stripping (no tsc spawn, no .bin/tsc shim). Requires
          # Node >= 22.18 / 24. No `npm ci` — the test only touches node builtins
          # and the self-contained launch-vehicles module.
          node-version: '24'

      - name: Golden-numbers test (payloadAtC3 / deliveredMassKg)
        run: node --test tests/v2-golden/launch-vehicles.golden.test.mjs

  full-tests:
    name: full-tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Full test suite
        run: node tools/run-tests.mjs

docs.name: skyhook:.github/workflows/ci.yml
docs.text:
name: Physics Verification

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, dev]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Rev A Physics Assertions

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Install pytest
        run: pip install pytest openpyxl

      - name: Run Rev A physics assertions
        run: pytest tests/ -v --tb=short

      - name: Verify canonical parameters load cleanly
        run: python3 physics/skyhook_physics.py
